archetypes.name: dyn-grep-argv
archetypes.rationale: Line-based awk argv parsing is easy to regress across patterns, options, and path operands.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the lint-bare-grep-probe awk parsing changes. Focus on whether parent-directory ascents are checked only in path operands, all paths after the pattern are visited, and pattern or option values containing ../ stay allowed. Check interactions with --, quoted tokens, command/subshell wrappers, and the existing no-path stdin rule. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
